messages:
Lena: Quick final-lock thread for Predictor GA readiness. Target GA Monday 2026-04-06. Need explicit OKs on: SLA (p99/availability), docs (quickstart + migration), support runbook (billing dispute flow), monitoring & PD tuning, pricing guardrails. Call out any hidden deps.

Marco: SLA proposal: 99.95% monthly availability and p99 <= 700ms for hosted Standard. Load tests on canary show p99 ~670ms. One infra job (node autoscaler) has flaky restarts in ap-south, infra will patch tonight.

Dee: Docs status: quickstart + API examples done. Missing: billing examples and model-pin caveat paragraph. I can finish by Thu morning.

Harper: Support/runbook: triage checklist, escalation path and billing templates drafted. Outstanding: automated SLA credit script; we'll do manual credits for first 30 days.

Ibrahim: Monitoring/oncall: dashboards ready, PD rotation created. Current PD rule p99 > 800ms for 2m. Propose change to p99 > 750ms for 3m to reduce noise. Added cache hit-rate and token-cost dashboards.

Lena: Pricing/Commercial: keep GA list price identical to beta. Recommend a 2% warm-start token buffer for new orgs first 30 days to reduce accidental overages; legal must approve promo wording. Also sales wants a pilot for reserved capacity.

Marco: Hidden dep: redis upgrade for prefix-metrics scheduled Thu night; if it slips, hit-rate metrics won't be reliable.

Dee: Pinged @content for billing copy review and @legal for promo language.

Ibrahim: Adjusted PD threshold to p99 > 750ms for 3m; Slack-only alert at p99 > 950ms. Added runbook step: if cache hit < 65% escalate to infra.

Harper: Billing runbook will be attached to release ticket by Thu EOD. Manual credit steps documented.

legal-bot: Legal review requested for promo copy at 6823456805.

Marco: Infra patch merged at 6823456812, canary shows p99 660ms.

Lena: Owner check: Marco (SLA/infra) ✔ Dee (Docs) ✔ Ibrahim (Monitoring) ✔ Harper (Support) ✔ Legal pending. If legal OK by Fri AM, I'll create release ticket and send draft comms.
